newsitem.title: USA: Tyson has no comment yet on Williams case.
newsitem.headline: Tyson has no comment yet on Williams case.

text.p: Tyson Foods said it should have a statement soon regarding a federal grand jury's indictment against Tyson's Washington lobbyist Jack Williams, but until then it would not comment on the matter.

"We are still are little bit in the dark about this. We haven't seen the indictment yet and until we do, it's inappropriate for us to make any kind of comment about it" said Ed Nicholson, a spokesman for Tyson, the Arkansas-based poultry processor.

Williams was charged with making false statements to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the U.S. Department of Agriculture's office of the inspector general in the preliminary investigation of former U.S. Agriculture Secretary, Mike Espy.
Nicholson said the company should issue a statement after having read the indictment.
Espy, who resigned as Agriculture Secretary in 1994, is under investigation for allegedly receiving favors from companies and other concerns that the USDA oversees.
